items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cannonball Adderley was there... But I don’t think I would go over on a regular basis.

ctx.x: Since you mentioned that... 16. What clubs, and who do you recall seeing there? Was there anybody who to this day was life-changing?

Yeah, I think there were... Well, not life-changing. No. But there were some people there that I’m sure I heard, but I didn’t know who they were at that time. Because Fort Knox is like 50 miles down the road, and a lot of band people were there. Cannonball Adderley was there, and various other people. Stanley Turrentine was there. So they would come up to Louisville on the weekends. But I don’t think I would go over on a regular basis. But there was this place called the Diamond Horseshoe, and there was one…
But there was never any kind of challenge or animosity?
